last_24h_rule: each shared time/level/region at least95% within limits, plus 6-hour log RMSE trend reported
unverified_along_track: not evaluated if vertical datum/coordinate unresolved
comparison_sign: B minus A; baseline A is numerical reference, not truth
geometry_interpolation: log(DEN) per native ZG column; no extrapolation; both columns must cover query
reference_400_500_group: At each hour select A native ilev whose global median ZG is 400-500 km; compare same pressure indices separately from fixed geometric-height fields
no_growth_rule: Last24h OLS slope of global fixed-height log_RMSE <=0; report 6h bins without claiming independent-sample significance
coverage_rule: Report all common valid fractions, no newly invented numeric coverage acceptance threshold; partial coverage cannot imply whole-domain acceptance
along_track_status: N/A: unresolved external datum, no orbit experiment authorized
